result.note: A weekly round-up dominated by corporate deals. Only the BRICS meeting hosted by Doval is a checkable public-affairs fact, so one question tests that.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, Ajit Doval hosted China's Wang Yi and Russia's Sergei Shoigu in New Delhi at a meeting of which grouping?
questions.explain: Doval hosted Wang Yi and Sergei Shoigu at a BRICS table on Tuesday 23 June 2026. The same week, the US trade envoy wrapped up four days of talks in India, part of New Delhi's balancing between the powers.
questions.source: Doval hosted China's Wang Yi and Russia's Sergei Shoigu at a BRICS table on Tuesday
